mapper.select: SELECT memberIdx, email, TO_CHAR(birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS birth, profile_photo, tel, zip, addr1, addr2, gender, pref_position FROM member2 WHERE memberIdx = #{memberIdx}
SELECT p.uniform_no, p.height, p.weight, p.clubJoin_num FROM clubJoin cj JOIN player p ON p.clubJoin_num = cj.clubJoin_num WHERE cj.memberIdx = #{memberIdx} AND p.leave_date IS null
mapper.update: UPDATE player SET uniform_no = #{uniform_no}, height = #{height}, weight = #{weight} WHERE clubJoin_num = #{clubJoin_num}
UPDATE member1 SET userName = #{name} WHERE memberIdx = #{memberIdx}
